note: Thermophysiology per playable for the temperature map. Tier, body cover and the profile's own heat/cold statements set a comfort band on the felt temperature (°C). server/src/thermo.js adds the size shift from the adult combat weight; every quote must be verbatim in the profile or the build fails.

A.text: Warmblütig wie heutige Vögel: Der eigene Stoffwechsel heizt, Federn oder Flaum halten die Wärme. Gemessen an der gefühlten Temperatur, weil sie über Hecheln und Verdunstung kühlen.

B.text: Vermutlich warmblütig. Große Körper halten die Wärme gut, deshalb wird eher Hitze zum Problem. Gemessen an der gefühlten Temperatur.

C.text: Der riesige Körper hält die Wärme allein durch seine Masse, Luftsäcke helfen beim Kühlen. Hitze ist das größere Risiko als Kälte. Gemessen an der gefühlten Temperatur.

D.text: Zwischen warm- und wechselwarm: Die Studien widersprechen sich (Wiemann 2022 niedrig, Dawson 2020 bis 44 °C bei Maiasaura). Braucht mehr Wärme als ein Raubsaurier, verträgt aber auch mehr Hitze. Gemessen an der gefühlten Temperatur.

E.text: Wechselwarm: Der Körper nimmt die Temperatur der Umgebung an. Gemessen wird deshalb, was am Körper ankommt: Luft, Sonne und der Boden, auf dem das Tier liegt (die gefühlte Temperatur gilt für schwitzende Menschen). Warane halten sich am liebsten bei 35 bis 37 °C, ab etwa 42 °C wird es lebensgefährlich, unter 18 °C werden sie träge.

calibration: The bands are set for animals adapted to a Cretaceous greenhouse climate: their home POIs should be livable in their active hours, with stress at the extremes (dry-season noon in the open, cold nights for ectotherms). Too hot or too cold in the open with shade or water at hand is an ordinary rest, not a danger.
compassNote: Thermo compass for land ectotherms (adults only): ideal = the body temperature range they aim for (crocodiles about 30 to 33 °C, monitors run warmer). smallPools = false keeps a playable out of ponds and small swamp pools, as its profile says. dens = false: no burrow as a refuge (the crocodiles spend nights and hot hours in water, as their profiles say; monitors dig). The compass compares the options inside one POI right now and simulates nothing.
waterNote: Aquatic playables are rated on the water itself: waterBand = [too cold below, cool below, warm above, too hot above] in °C water, set by hand (no size or cover shift), the deep layer is their refuge from heat. Water draws heat about 25 times faster than air, so these bands sit higher than air bands. gills = breathes in the water, so warm water low in oxygen counts too.
rulesNote: band = [too cold below, cool below, warm above, too hot above] on the felt temperature. Cover: cold = K the cold side moves down, heat = K the hot side moves. Size: bigger keeps heat (whole band moves down by perDoubling per doubling of combat weight against the reference), ectotherms half. Per playable: heat/cold = extra tolerance in K from the profile (positive = tolerates more), water = cools off in water or mud, aquatic = lives only in water (rated once water temperature exists).

achillobator.de: Gefiederter Nachtjäger: Kälte macht ihm wenig aus, die Tagessonne meidet er.
quotes: They prefer shaded or dimly lit areas during the day, and follow shadows in order to stay in the shade, even as the sun shifts.
Achillobator are nocturnal, often traveling far distances under the cooler and more comfortable cloak of night.

albertaceratops.de: Leidet unter der Hitze der Trockenzeit und kühlt sich in Pfützen und Schlamm.
quotes: The scorching heat and shrinking water sources drive the sett to live closer to rivers.
During the cooler evening hours, the entire sett rests together in these puddles, taking advantage of the lower temperatures during their downtime.

alioramus.de: Gefiederter Sonnenanbeter: sucht warme, sonnige Plätze.
quotes: Sunbathing is a cherished pastime for Alioramus.
They often take brief naps in particularly sunny spots, relishing in the warmth against their feathers.

allosaurus.de: Mag es warm und schwül. Die kühle Regenzeit verdirbt ihm die Laune.
quotes: Allosaurus favors the dry season, when marshes become humid and warm.
During the rainy season, Allosaurus grow disgruntled by the shift in temperature and the near-constant downpour, often seeking out caves or overhangs that offer relief from the rain.

amargasaurus.de: Kühlt sich in den warmen Stunden im flachen Wasser.
quotes: During the warmer parts of the day, they particularly enjoy walking through and wallowing in shallow water, letting it cool their skin, and usually choose to nest nearby.

anodontosaurus.de: Gepanzerter Ankylosaurier. Das Profil sagt nichts zur Temperatur, deshalb gelten die Standardwerte.

apatosaurus.de: Riesenkörper mit Hitzeproblem: Schlamm und Wasser kühlen, in der Trockenzeit ist er gereizt.
quotes: They settle down and begin rolling and rubbing the mud against their skin, keen to coat it as a form of protection against biting insects, and also cool it from the baking heat.
Though typically patient with their species, Apatosaurus can become remarkably cantankerous - particularly during the dry season when water, shade and food becomes scarce.

argentinosaurus.de: Der größte Körper der Insel hält die Wärme fast von selbst. Das Risiko ist Hitze.
quotes: When settling for the night, Argentinosaurus can be seen cuddling together for warmth and comfort.

austroraptor.de: Die Federn sind nicht wasserdicht: Bei Regen und nachts kuschelt er sich zum Wärmen an andere.
quotes: Austroraptor huddle together to preserve warmth often, especially when raining, snowing, or at night.

barsboldia.de: An Hitze angepasst, kühlt sich aber trotzdem gern in Regen, Schatten und Wasser.
quotes: Barsoldia are well adapted to the heat.
Barsboldia often rest in shade or in water, but prefer clean water to dirty water.

camptosaurus.de: Wärmeliebend: sonnt sich am Strand. Regen und Kälte mag er gar nicht.
quotes: Camptosaurus have a natural love for warmth, spending large portions of their day sunbathing and playing in the sun.
Rain, on the other hand, is strongly disliked by Camptosaurus, with many retreating into cover at the first drop, eager to stay out the cold.

ceratosaurus.de: Mittelgroßer Raubsaurier. Das Profil sagt nichts zur Temperatur, deshalb gelten die Standardwerte.

citipati.de: Liebt Sonne und Wärme, die Federn schützen vor Kälte.
quotes: Citipati adore being in the sun and will stretch and bask in the rays whenever possible.

compsognathus.de: Winzig: verliert schnell Wärme, verträgt dafür Hitze besser als die Großen.

concavenator.de: Sonnt sich gern und kühlt sich im Wasser ab.
quotes: Concavenator return frequently to familiar water sources - not only to cool down, but also to forage, hydrate, and escape danger.
Concavenator are often seen basking and sleeping in the sun, and swimming around in shallow water while the rest of their gang.

daspletosaurus.de: Großer Tyrannosaurier: sucht in der Mittagshitze Schatten.
quotes: When the pack is ready to settle down for a brief period of time, Daspletosaurus seek out shaded spots, most often during the hottest part of the day.

deinocheirus.de: Groß, gefiedert und am Ufer zu Hause: sonnt sich und kühlt sich im Flachwasser.
quotes: Much of their time is spent relaxing by the shore, basking and enjoying their company.
They invite their Struthiomimus friends to cool off in the shallows, positioning themselves protectively between them and the deeper waters.

deinonychus.de: Gefiedert, sucht aber gern warme Orte und kuschelt in der Regenzeit.
quotes: They increasingly prefer warmer locations, and cuddle closer to other Deinonychus for warmth during the Rainy Season.

deinosuchus.de: Wechselwarm: tankt Wärme in der Sonne, kühlt sich im Wasser, und nachts hält ihn das Wasser warm.
quotes: In order to properly regulate their body temperature, they require long exposure to the sun on their thick skin.
During particularly hot periods - particularly in the Dry Season - they may retreat to cooler waters, or move over to shaded areas to prevent themselves from overheating.
At night, Deinosuchus returns almost exclusively to the water, submerging into deeper water when needing additional warmth.
Deinosuchus do not enter small pools of water - such as the ponds at Wilderness Peak, Hot Springs, Impact Crater, Whistling Columns or Savanna Grasslands.

dilophosaurus.de: Sonnt sich auf warmem Fels und passt seine Farbe der Jahreszeit an.
quotes: Dilophosaurus tend to be lazier during the day, preferring to find rocks or clearings to lay and sunbathe on.
In the rainy season, they may shift a darker hue to absorb warmth, and in the dry season, they may shift to a lighter hue to reflect it.

dryosaurus.de: Klein und empfindlich: mittags in den Schatten, an kalten Abenden wird gekuschelt.
quotes: In the dry season, Dryosaurus adults spend the hottest parts of the day resting in shaded areas or near water sources, becoming more active during cooler mornings and evenings.
In the rainy season, during particularly cold evenings, Dryosaurus individuals can be observed huddling close together for warmth.
They are quite fond of laying in the sunlight and are often given the responsibility of watching over calves while other mothers take a break.

eurhinosaurus.de: Ichthyosaurier aus den warmen Flachmeeren des Jura: schneller Schwimmer, der seine Wärme selbst hält. Bewertet an der Wassertemperatur, die Tiefe ist sein Rückzug.

giganotosaurus.de: Riesiger Jäger: flieht vor der Hitze in Schatten und Wasser.
quotes: Giganotosaurus enjoy water and napping in the shade.
Giganotosaurus enjoy resting under the shade, whether it be under a tree or beside a cliff side, in order to temporarily escape the heat.

halszkaraptor.de: Winziger Taucher: Nasse Federn kühlen aus, deshalb geht er danach in die Sonne.
quotes: When back on land, Halszkaraptor spend a considerable amount of time preening one another, and locating a sunny rock to bask on to help dry their plumage.

hatzegopteryx.de: Flugsaurier mit Pyknofasern: badet in der Trockenzeit zum Abkühlen.
quotes: They can be spotted taking brief, cooling baths in shallow pools during the dry season.

iguanodon.de: Geht bei harter Sonne gern ins Wasser.
quotes: Iguanodon are a fully terrestrial species, but enjoy spending time in water - especially during the harsh sun in the dry season.

kaiwhekea.de: Plesiosaurier aus den kühlen Meeren Neuseelands: verträgt kaltes Wasser gut, sehr warmes Lagunenwasser weniger.
quotes: They can be spotted basking in shallow waters or even on land for a short period of time.

kelenken.de: Laufvogel mit Federkleid, sicher warmblütig. Das Profil sagt nichts weiter zur Temperatur.

kentrosaurus.de: Überhitzt mittags leicht und ist in der Morgen- und Abendkühle am aktivsten.
quotes: In the hotter midday hours, Kentrosaurus opt to seek shade under trees or rocky overhangs, preferring to rest to avoid overheating - especially in the Dry Season.

During the cooler early morning of dawn, and the cooler period as the sun goes down at dusk, Kentrosaurus are at their most energetic - often engaging in playful sparring, running in open spaces, and shaking their bodies against trees and vegetation.

lambeosaurus.de: Hadrosaurier. Das Profil sagt nichts zur Temperatur, deshalb gelten die Standardwerte.

latenivenatrix.de: Gefiederter Troodontide, von Geburt an warmblütig.
quotes: They hatch with feathers and basic abilities to thermoregulate, but instinctively huddle close to their siblings and brooding parent for better warmth retention.

leedsichthys.de: Riesiger Filtrierer mit Kiemen: Warmes Wasser hält wenig Sauerstoff, deshalb wird es ihm früher zu warm als den Luftatmern.

lurdusaurus.de: Extrem hitze- und sonnenempfindlich: bleibt tagsüber fast nur im Wasser.
quotes: During the day, Lurdusaurus almost exclusively prefer to remain in water, only leaving to go on land when needing to forage, escape a semi-aquatic or aquatic predator, or to roll in mud and bask.
This makes them incredibly prone to overheating or even burning from the sun, which can make them especially irritable in the Dry Season.

maip.de: Nachtjäger mit lichtempfindlicher Haut: überhitzt tagsüber sehr schnell.
quotes: However, in the day, they will seek cooler areas such as water pools and heavily shaded foliage, as these Maip have a tendency to overheat easily.
They have scales and eyes that are very sensitive to light and take care to shade if caught out during the day.

megalania-arid.de: Wüstenwaran: wechselwarm, sonnt sich auf Fels und verträgt viel Hitze.
quotes: Megalania are very lazy, and spend a lot of time either cooling down in shade, warming up in the sun, or floating in water.
Arid offspring explore independently, preferring sunny rocks to bask on alone.

megalania-temperate.de: Waran aus gemäßigten Gegenden: wechselwarm, kommt aber mit kühleren Tagen besser klar.
quotes: Megalania are very lazy, and spend a lot of time either cooling down in shade, warming up in the sun, or floating in water.
Temperate variants are more tolerant of others and sometimes engage in group basking.

metriacanthosaurus.de: Seine Schuppen vertragen trockene Hitze schlecht: tagsüber in Höhle, Schatten oder Wasser.
quotes: During the dry season, Metriacanthosaurus prefer to remain in caves throughout the day, as their scales are sensitive to the dry heat.
Metricanthosaurus may overheat or dry out, especially during the day in Dry Season, so as a result must find shaded areas, caves, deep foliage, or shallow water to rest in.

pachycephalosaurus.de: Sucht nachts warmen Fels und die Wärme anderer Tiere.
quotes: At night they retreat to safety - ideally a raised structure built of rock still warm from the morning sun.

pachyrhinosaurus.de: Robust und kälteerprobt (Verwandte lebten im polaren Alaska), kühlt die Füße im Schlamm.
quotes: During rest, they enjoy mud rolling to soothe itchy skin, and when near rivers they walk in the shallow water, cooling their calloused feet in the mud.

parasaurolophus.de: Wanderer: legt sich zum Abkühlen ins flache Wasser.
quotes: Due to their continuous migration, some Parasaurolophus may be found laying in shallow water for a short periods of time to relax and cool off.

psittacosaurus.de: Kleiner Ceratopsier: verliert Wärme schneller als die Großen.

pycnonemosaurus.de: Sonnt sich gern und kühlt sich im Schlamm.
quotes: When not playing or sniffing out prey, Pycnonemosaurus never bypasses the opportunity to bask in the sun, and take a quick swim in shallow water as the weather cools.
Pycnonemosaurus love sitting and laying in mud to cool off and protect their skin from sun and parasites.

quetzalcoatlus.de: Braucht die Sonne für die Thermik, Pyknofasern halten warm.
quotes: Quetzalcoatlus are often seen roosting communally, and most often in the early morning or at night, when they must wait for the sun to generate rising thermals to make it easier for flight.

rhamphorhynchus.de: Winziger Flugsaurier: kühlt schnell aus, der Flaum hilft.

sarcosuchus.de: Wechselwarm und hitzeliebend: sonnt sich lange und kühlt sich im tiefen Wasser.
quotes: They adore the heat, and spend a lot of time basking on river banks while nestled in vegetation.
During the Dry Season, Sarcosuchus propel themselves rapidly through the cooler water at the deep to regulate their body temperature.

spinosaurus.de: Das Segel regelt die Temperatur, dazu kühlt er sich im Wasser.
quotes: All Spinosaurus bask frequently, aiming to direct their large sails directly in line of the sun's rays.
The blood vessels on the sail help control their body temperature, either absorbing or releasing heat as needed.

stegosaurus.de: Sonnt sich gern (die Platten helfen beim Wärmehaushalt) und badet in der Hitze.
quotes: Stegosaurus are cathemeral, and spend most of the day lounging and basking in the sun.
Stegosaurus deeply enjoy bathing - especially during the day, when the heat of the sun can feel exhausting.

struthiomimus.de: Gefiederter Läufer, sicher warmblütig. Das Profil nennt keine Besonderheiten.

styracosaurus.de: Kühlt sich in den heißesten Stunden im Wasser.
quotes: Styracosaurus like to cool off in shallow water during the hottest hours, even rolling in the mud to protect their skin and wounds.
Suchomimus enjoy the sun's rays and spend some time basking at the water's edge whenever the opportunity presents itself.

tenontosaurus.de: Regelt die Temperatur an heißen Tagen mit Schlamm und Wasser.
quotes: During the Dry Season's hottest days, Tenontosaurus rolls in mud or submerge themselves in water to help regulate their temperature.

therizinosaurus.de: Großer gefiederter Nachtaktiver: tagsüber im tiefen Schatten.
quotes: Therizinosaurus will prefer to stick to heavily shaded areas during the daytime, if forced to move.

torvosaurus.de: Liebt Hitze und warmen Sand, Kälte mag er nicht.
quotes: Torvosaurus typically prefer the Dry Season for its hotter temperatures, and love rolling and shaking around in dust baths and warm sands.
The Rainy Season can prompt more grumpy behavior in Torvosaurus - particularly when raining or snowing, as they do not like the cold.

tropeognathus.de: Fischender Flugsaurier: sonnt sich nur kurz zum Trocknen.
quotes: They will, however, bask for short periods of time, extending their wings to dry them out in the sun.

tylosaurus.de: Mosasaurier der warmen Kreidemeere: fühlt sich zwischen 20 und 30 °C wohl, kühlt sich in der Tiefe ab. An Land droht schnell der Hitzetod.
quotes: The further a Tylosaurus goes on land, the higher the risk they have of becoming dehydrated and dying to the heat.

tyrannosaurus.de: Sonnt sich gern und kühlt sich in der Trockenzeit im Flachwasser.
quotes: Tyrannosaurus enjoy basking in sunlight when not directly attempting to hunt.
In the Dry Season, they can be observed resting in shallow banks of water in order to cool down, drawing their muzzle through the water.

tyrannotitan.de: Nachtaktiv: Die Tageshitze macht ihn träge, abkühlen geht im Teich oder im Meer.
quotes: Tyrannotitan are strong swimmers, and often swim in small ponds or in ocean water to cool off.

During the daytime, their energy shifts and Tyrannotitan grow tired; the heat of the day turning these tyrants into lazy creatures, unwilling to rise or expend too much energy unless loud sounds or heavy steps wake them.

yunnanosaurus.de: Die ledrige Haut schützt vor der Sonne, trotzdem wandert er lieber in der kühlen Nacht.
quotes: Yunnanosaurus have a smooth but tough, leathery hide that protects them from the sun's rays and shields their bodies from insects.
This species migrates mostly at night due to the cooler air and to avoid the risk of dehydration from the heat of the sun.

yutyrannus.de: Dichtes Federkleid: liebt Kühle und Regen und flieht vor der Hitze der Trockenzeit.
quotes: They prefer the rainy season for its more temperate or cold temperatures, and love the rain, stepping out into it and shaking their heads upwards.
In contrast, Yutyrannus prefer to stay inside dark and dim dens during the dry season, wanting to avoid the heat as much as possible.
